posts.title: Record Placement Season 2024
posts.content: We are proud to announce that HIT has achieved a record 98% placement rate this year with the highest package of 45 LPA. Our students continue to excel in their careers!

posts.title: New Partnership with Google Cloud
posts.content: Exciting news! HIT has signed an MOU with Google Cloud for advanced computing curriculum and student certifications. This partnership will enhance our students' skills in cloud technologies.

posts.title: Industry 4.0 Lab Inauguration
posts.content: HIT inaugurates state-of-the-art Industry 4.0 Lab equipped with robotic arms, IoT sensors, and smart manufacturing equipment. This facility will prepare our students for the future of manufacturing.

posts.title: Research Excellence Award
posts.content: Congratulations to Dr. Rajesh Kumar from CSE Department for receiving the Research Excellence Award for outstanding contributions in Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning.
